stock-concealed-sniper-shot.head: 594fed86
stock-concealed-sniper-shot.scope: Stock verified Concealment admission, sight and range refusals, the six-second direct Rifle cast, the same-target resistance witness, and the natural linked Stun with independent immunity.

controls.source: GOB 505 stores a 50% terminal Stun on a 0.01 s marker, with four seconds for the linked Stun and control immunity. The archived victim shows the linked 102/163 record.
controls.runtime: The captured marker retires, then the landed effect applies 102 and its linked -20 together with independent 734/681. The timer prevents replacement and the original stack retires in order.
controls.test: SniperShotSendsTheArchivedVictimStunStackAndLinkedTactics and ConcealedAndSniperShotsUseTheirOwnDelayedStunProbabilities exercise the exact record ordering, attack consumer, chance and expiry. Native saw marker 280 retire before the four-second linked records 281–284, all paired. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/888#issuecomment-7093732288

targeting.source: GOB 505 requires a rifle-category weapon, Rifles style, Concealment and a hostile within 30 m from rest.
targeting.runtime: The ordinary request keeps its target view and spawn through the cast, rechecks sight, range, rifle, original combat state and loaded style, and consumes Concealment on admission.
targeting.test: SniperShotBindsItsConcealedRifleCastToTheOriginalLiveTarget covers the complete gates and loss cases. Stock refused the exposed attempt locally, returned 9 and 34 at the blocked and far stands without a debit, and admitted the visible target from PICK. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/888#issuecomment-7093732288

choreography.source: The GOB's outside-combat rule specifies a six-second direct shot. The named archived impact and Stun precede a separate generic next-move change.
choreography.runtime: The ordinary Rifle cast uses the direct selected-target hit path, presenting the cast and paired impact state without generating an interlock round.
choreography.test: Stock presented the six-second cast and direct impact, including the armored sample and the natural Stun release. Retained archive context and the stock route support a direct presentation. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/888#issuecomment-7093732288

505.note: Stock measured 52 and raw52/final47 under +20 Ballistic. The archived 1660 damage with 182 absorbed keeps the original scaling and source-parity checks open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/888#issuecomment-7093732288
